## Verified detail — invoice cancellation & treasury vouchers

Read by hand from the repo on 2026-07-27 (the generator above only counts files).
These are the real paths; ticket `touches` entries come from here.

### Cancel path today

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `apps/api/src/modules/pos/controllers/invoice.controller.ts` | `POST /invoices/:id/cancel` (line 198) |
| `apps/api/src/modules/pos/services/cancel-invoice.service.ts` | status→CANCELLED, settles `invoice_debts`, reverts promotions, publishes event |
| `apps/api/src/modules/pos/publishers/invoice-cancelled.publisher.ts` | `INVOICE_CANCELLED` payload: `{invoiceId, documentNumber, reason, branchId, items[], organizationId, actorId}` — **carries no payment data** |
| `apps/api/src/modules/accounting/consumers/journal-reverse.consumer.ts` | reverses the sale journal entry |
| `apps/api/src/modules/accounting/deposit-refund/deposit-refund.service.ts` | reverses the deposit-fund **movement** (non-cash lines) — creates **no voucher** |
| `apps/api/src/modules/inventory/consumers/stock-return.consumer.ts` | RETURN_IN to `item.locationId` (the location captured on the invoice line) |

**Gap confirmed by reading every `INVOICE_CANCELLED` consumer:** nothing reverses the
**cash** fund. A cash sale posts a withdrawal-less receipt that survives cancellation, so
`cash_accounts.balance` stays inflated. No phiếu chi / phiếu thu is produced on either leg.

No frontend calls `/invoices/{id}/cancel` — verified against `apps/pos-web/src/services/invoice.service.ts`
(has checkout, checkout-return, redeem-points, delete; no cancel) and backoffice.

### Checkout path (what cancellation must undo)

`apps/api/src/modules/pos/services/checkout-invoice.service.ts`
- CASH lines → `CashFromPaymentPublisher` → `PosCashSaleConsumer` → `CashReceiptsService.createAndPostInternal`
  → cash movement + JE + **phiếu thu** (`cash_receipts`, purpose `POS_SALE`, referenceType `INVOICE`, referenceId = invoiceId)
- non-CASH lines → `DepositFromPaymentPublisher` → deposit consumer → deposit movement + JE (no bank voucher today)
- `invoice_payments` stores `paymentMethod`, `amount`, `accountId` (COA), `depositAccountId` — the refund routing key

### Voucher services available for reuse

| Path | Reusable entry point |
|---|---|
| `apps/api/src/modules/accounting/cash-vouchers/cash-payments/cash-payments.service.ts` | `createAndPostInternal`, `createVoucherForMovement`, `reverse` |
| `apps/api/src/modules/accounting/cash-vouchers/cash-receipts/cash-receipts.service.ts` | `createAndPostInternal`, `reverse` (same-table reversal, sets `reverses_voucher_id` / `reversed_by_voucher_id`) |
| `apps/api/src/modules/accounting/deposit-vouchers/bank-payments/bank-payments.service.ts` | `createAndPostInternal`, `createVoucherForMovement`, `reverse` |
| `apps/api/src/modules/accounting/cash-vouchers/cash-voucher-consumers/refund-cash.consumer.ts` | **closest existing analogue** — POS return refund → cash movement + phiếu chi, in one transaction |
| `apps/api/src/modules/accounting/cash/cash-fund-resolver.service.ts` | `resolveBranchCashFund(orgId, branchId)` — one cash fund per branch |
| `apps/api/src/modules/pos/services/resolve-branch-item-locations.ts` | `showroomOnly: true` — the existing "credit stock to the showroom" helper |

### Cross-reference columns that already exist

`cash_receipts` / `cash_payments` / `bank_payments` each carry `reverses_voucher_id` and
`reversed_by_voucher_id`, but the FK is **same-table** (receipt↔receipt, payment↔payment).
A receipt↔payment link across tables has no column today.

### Conventions that bind this feature

- Backend source is English-only; Vietnamese only in voucher `description` strings shown to users
  (see `refund-cash.consumer.ts`: `Hoàn tiền trả hàng ${code}`) and in the frontend.
- Migrations are hand-written under `apps/api/src/database/migrations/`; `synchronize: false`.
  `migrationsTransactionMode: 'each'`.
- Posted vouchers are immutable: corrections go through `reverse`, never an edit.
- Consumers dedupe via `processed_events` + a unique reference lookup before writing.
